entries.name: Lake Side Park
entries.content:
A narrow, rutted road winds its way through the woods before spilling out into the lot itself, which is little more than a clearing carved from the wilderness. The ground is uneven and pockmarked with deep tire tracks left behind by previous visitors - some undoubtedly eager to make their escape once their business here was concluded.

To one side of the parking area, the land slopes gently down towards the lake's edge. A few weathered picnic tables and a rustic fire pit mark this as a popular spot for daytime picnics and family outings during the warmer months. But by night, the scene takes on an entirely different character.

The water lies still and quiet under the moon's silvered gaze, its surface reflecting the star-flecked sky above like a shimmering mirror. On clear nights like this one, it's easy to imagine that you're not just in another part of town - but some enchanted realm where the usual rules and mores no longer apply.
